how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

sentences.ar: الـpipeline هو نفس السجل وهو ماشي من مصدر لمستهلك، وكل الحاجات المهمة بتحصل عند المحطات.
sentences.en: A pipeline is the same record travelling from a source to a consumer, and everything interesting happens at the hops.

sentences.ar: Extract من ملف أو API أو database.
sentences.en: Extract from a file, an API or a database.

sentences.ar: وبعدها validate قبل أي تحويل كبير، لأن إنك تحوّل داتا بايظة بينتج داتا بايظة غالية.
sentences.en: Then validate — before any large transformation, because transforming bad data just produces expensive bad data.

sentences.ar: والفحوص دي مملة وهي الشغل نفسه: الـschema مطابق؟
sentences.en: The checks are boring and they are the job: does the schema match?
Are the types right, are mandatory fields present?

sentences.ar: في duplicates؟ الـkeys بتوصل؟ القيم في المدى؟
sentences.en: Are there duplicates, do the keys resolve, are the values in range?

sentences.ar: العدد مطابق للي المصدر قال إنه بعته؟
sentences.en: Does the count match what the source said it sent?

sentences.ar: ودلوقتي ست أبعاد جودة، محسوبة على المباشر على الصفوف الحقيقية مش مكتوبة في slide.
sentences.en: Now six quality dimensions, computed live against the real rows rather than asserted in a slide.

sentences.ar: Completeness وuniqueness وvalidity وtimeliness وconsistency وaccuracy.
sentences.en: Completeness, uniqueness, validity, timeliness, consistency, accuracy.

sentences.ar: وأهو حاجة متسابة عن قصد: الداتا النضيفة دي لسه بتفشل في فحصين.
sentences.en: And here is something deliberately left in: this clean, seeded dataset still fails two checks.

sentences.ar: صف بيشاور على عميل مش موجود، وصف شايل status بره المجال المعلَن.
sentences.en: One row points at a customer who does not exist, and one row carries a status outside the declared domain.

sentences.ar: ولا واحد فيهم اتحقن بزرار demo دول موجودين في الداتا فعلاً.
sentences.en: Neither was injected by a demo button — they are genuinely in the data.

sentences.ar: الـquality gate الحقيقي بيلاقي عيب قديم من أول تشغيلة، وإنك توسّع القاعدة عشان الـgate يبقى أخضر كان هيبقى الحل الغلط.
sentences.en: A real quality gate finds a pre-existing defect on its first run, and widening the rule to make the gate green would have been the wrong fix.

sentences.ar: الـETL بتحوّل قبل التحميل؛ والـELT بتحمّل raw وتحوّل جوه الـwarehouse.
sentences.en: ETL transforms before loading; ELT loads raw and transforms inside the warehouse.

sentences.ar: والاختيار عن compute وgovernance وlatency وplatform، مش عن الموضة.
sentences.en: The choice is about compute, governance, latency and platform, not fashion.

sentences.ar: وأي حاجة تفشل، حطّها في quarantine ومعاها سببها.
sentences.en: And whatever fails, quarantine it with its reason attached.

sentences.ar: الصف اللي رميته في الهدوء هو رقم غلط بعدين ومحدش قادر يقول ليه.
sentences.en: A row you silently dropped is a number that will be wrong downstream with nobody able to say why.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.

concepts.def_en: Extract, Load, Transform: load raw data into the warehouse as it is, then transform it there using the warehouse's own compute.
concepts.def_ar: Extract وLoad وTransform: بنحمّل الداتا الخام في الـwarehouse زي ما هي، وبعدين نحوّلها جواه بقوة حسابه.

concepts.def_en: The time between sending a request and receiving the response; usually tracked as percent…

concepts.def_en: Routing rows that fail validation to a separate table with the reason, isolating bad data for review without stopping the clean flow.

concepts.failure: Silently dropping bad rows instead of quarantining them with a reason.

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
A payload travelling through 2-8 stations; a station can fail and be fixed.
Trunk chapter title card (riser + sting in the SFX map).
